$comment: P127 cross-runtime primitive interface and generic math parity fixture. Each case calls a static Probe function of `source` on a fresh session; `returns` pins its result and `refuses` its error. The web half runs the cases through `neo test` (cli/src/commands/primitive-interfaces-parity.test.ts); the Unity half, P127PrimitiveInterfaceParityTests, runs them over a `neo export` of the same source, with the export's generated C# compiled beside it. Vendor this file verbatim.
source: class Money(int cents) : IUnit<Money>, IParsable<Money>, IAdditiveIdentity<Money, Money> {
public static Money Unit => new Money(100);
public static Money Parse(string s) => new Money(int.Parse(s));
public static Money AdditiveIdentity => new Money(0);
public void Add(T amount) { Count += amount; }
public void Set(T value) { Value = value; }
public static Cash Zero => new Cash(0);
public static Cash One => new Cash(1);
public static Cash AdditiveIdentity => new Cash(0);
public static Cash MultiplicativeIdentity => new Cash(1);
public static Cash operator +(Cash left, Cash right) => new Cash(left.Cents + right.Cents);
public static Cash operator -(Cash left, Cash right) => new Cash(left.Cents - right.Cents);
public static Cash operator *(Cash left, Cash right) => new Cash(left.Cents * right.Cents);
public static Cash operator /(Cash left, Cash right) => new Cash(left.Cents / right.Cents);
public static Cash operator %(Cash left, Cash right) => new Cash(left.Cents % right.Cents);
public static Cash operator -(Cash value) => new Cash(-value.Cents);
public static Cash operator +(Cash value) => value;
public static Cash operator ++(Cash value) => new Cash(value.Cents + 1);
public static Cash operator --(Cash value) => new Cash(value.Cents - 1);
public static Cash Parse(string s) => new Cash(int.Parse(s));
public bool Equals(Cash other) => Cents == other.Cents;
public bool Equals(Coin other) => Cents == other.Cents;
public int CompareTo(Ver other) => N - other.N;
public int CompareTo(int other) => N - other;
class Line(int n, Ver? v, Cash? price) {
static bool SameEq<T extends IEquatable<T>>(T a, T b) => a.Equals(b);
static int HashOf<T extends IEquatable<T>>(T a) => a.GetHashCode();
static int Cmp<T extends IComparable<T>>(T a, T b) => a.CompareTo(b);
static string Fmt<T extends IFormattable>(T v) => v.ToString("F2");
static string ShowEq<T extends IEquatable<T>>(T v) => $"[{v}]";
static bool IsFloat<T>(T v) => v is float;
static bool IsInt<T>(T v) => v is int;
static bool IsEqFloat<T>(T v) => v is IEquatable<float>;
static bool IsCmpInt(IEquatable<int> e) => e is IComparable<int>;
static bool IsDecimal<T>(T v) => v is decimal;
static bool IsString<T>(T v) => v is string;
static bool EqAny<T>(T a, T b) => a == b;
static bool EqConstrained<T extends IEquatable<T>>(T a, T b) => a == b;
static bool SameAny<T, U>(T a, U b) => a == b;
static bool PairEq(IEquatable<int> a, IEquatable<int> b) => a == b;
static bool Lt<T extends IComparable<T>>(T a, T b) => a < b;
static bool Less(IComparable<int> a, int b) => a < b;
static bool Greater(int b, IComparable<int> a) => b > a;
static string Digits(List<Ver> vs) => vs.Select((v) => $"{v.N}").Aggregate("", (a, b) => a + b);
static List<Ver> Versions() => [new Ver(3), new Ver(1), new Ver(2)];
static T MinOf<T extends IComparable<T>>(List<T> xs) => xs.Min();
static string Sorted<T extends IComparable<T>>(List<T> xs) => xs.OrderBy((x) => x).Select((x) => $"{x}").Aggregate("", (a, b) => a + "," + b);
static T Total<T extends INumberBase<T>>(List<T> xs) => xs.Sum();
static T Twice<T extends IGrow<T>>(T s) => s.Grow().Grow();
static T Zero<T extends INumberBase<T>>() => T.Zero;
static T One<T extends INumberBase<T>>() => T.One;
static T Unit<T extends IMultiplicativeIdentity<T, T>>() => T.MultiplicativeIdentity;
static T Parse<T extends IParsable<T>>(string s) => T.Parse(s);
static T? TryParse<T extends IParsable<T>>(string s) => T.TryParse(s);
static T UnitOf<T extends IUnit<T>>() => T.Unit;
static string LabelOf<T extends IUnit<T>>() => T.Label();
public static bool IntTryParseNull() => TryParse<int>("4x") == null;
public static bool ParseBool() => Parse<bool>(" TRUE ");
public static bool BoolTryParseNull() => TryParse<bool>("yes") == null;
public static bool MoneyTryParseNull() => TryParse<Money>("x") == null;
public static int TotalsInt() => new Totals<int>().Total;
public static bool BoolParse() => bool.Parse(" True ");
public static bool BoolStaticTryParseNull() => bool.TryParse("yes") == null;
public static string Vector2Format() => new Vector2(1.5, 2).ToString("F1");
public static string Vector3IntFormat() => new Vector3Int(1, 2, 3).ToString("D2");
public static string ColorFormat() => new Tint().Value.ToString("F2");
public static bool Vector2Equals() => new Vector2(1, 2).Equals(new Vector2(1, 2));
public static int Vector2IntHash() => new Vector2Int(1, 2).GetHashCode();
public static int Vector3Hash() => new Vector3(1, 0, -1).GetHashCode();
public static string GenericDecimalFormat() { int n = 3; return Fmt<decimal>(n); }
public static bool InterfaceRowEquals() => ViaInterface(new Wrap<int>(5));
public static bool CoinEquals() { Coin a = new(5); Coin b = new(5); return a == b; }
public static bool CoinCollisionDiffers() { Coin a = new(5); Coin b = new(7); return a != b; }
public static bool CoinGenericEquals() => EqAny<Coin>(new Coin(5), new Coin(5));
public static bool CoinConstrainedEquals() => EqConstrained<Coin>(new Coin(5), new Coin(5));
public static bool CoinInterfaceEquals() { IEquatable<Coin> a = new Coin(7); return a == new Coin(7); }
public static bool CoinBesideInterface() { IEquatable<Coin> a = new Coin(1); Coin b = new(1); return b == a; }
public static bool PlainEquals() { Plain a = new(1); Plain b = new(1); return a == b; }
public static bool PlainGenericEquals() => EqAny<Plain>(new Plain(1), new Plain(1));
public static bool PlainSameEquals() { Plain a = new(1); return EqAny<Plain>(a, a); }
public static bool DecimalBesideString() => SameAny<decimal, string>(1.10, "1.1");
public static bool IntBesideFloat() => SameAny<int, float>(3, 3.0);
public static bool StringBesideString() => SameAny<string, string>("1.10", "1.1");
public static bool IntBesideRow() => PairEq(3, new Wrap<int>(3));
public static bool InterfaceIntEqualsLiteral() { IEquatable<int> x = 3; return x == 3 && 3 == x; }
public static bool InterfaceFloatEqualsLiteral() { IEquatable<float> x = 2.5; return x == 2.5; }
public static int CoinToSetCount() { List<Coin> l = [new Coin(1), new Coin(1), new Coin(2), new Coin(3), new Coin(3)]; return l.ToSet().Count; }
public static int CoinDistinctCount() { List<Coin> l = [new Coin(1), new Coin(1), new Coin(2), new Coin(3), new Coin(3)]; return l.Distinct().Count(); }
public static int CoinLocalSetAdd() { List<Coin> e = []; Set<Coin> s = e.ToSet(); s.Add(new Coin(4)); s.Add(new Coin(4)); s.Add(new Coin(5)); return s.Count; }
public static bool CoinLocalSetContains() { List<Coin> e = []; Set<Coin> s = e.ToSet(); s.Add(new Coin(4)); return s.Contains(new Coin(4)); }
public static int CoinLocalSetRemove() { List<Coin> e = []; Set<Coin> s = e.ToSet(); s.Add(new Coin(4)); s.Add(new Coin(6)); s.Remove(new Coin(4)); return s.Count; }
public static int CoinTupleSetCount() { List<(Coin, int)> l = [(new Coin(1), 2), (new Coin(1), 2), (new Coin(1), 3)]; return l.ToSet().Count; }
public static int PlainDistinctCount() { List<Plain> l = [new Plain(1), new Plain(1)]; return l.Distinct().Count(); }
public static int PlainSameDistinctCount() { Plain p = new(1); List<Plain> l = [p, p]; return l.Distinct().Count(); }
public static int PlainGenericDistinctCount() => DistinctAny<Plain>([new Plain(1), new Plain(1)]);
public static bool RowLessThan() => new Ver(1) < new Ver(2);
public static bool RowAtLeast() => new Ver(1) >= new Ver(2);
public static bool GenericRowLessThan() => Lt<Ver>(new Ver(3), new Ver(2));
public static bool GenericBoolLessThan() => Lt<bool>(false, true);
public static bool InterfaceRowLessThan() => Less(new Score(5), 4);
public static bool IntGreaterThanRow() => Greater(4, new Score(3));
public static string OrderByComparable() => Digits(Versions().OrderBy((v) => v));
public static string OrderByDescendingComparable() => Digits(Versions().OrderByDescending((v) => v));
public static string SortComparable() { List<Ver> l = Versions(); l.Sort(); return Digits(l); }
public static int MinByComparable() => [new Line(7, new Ver(5), null), new Line(8, new Ver(4), null)].MinBy((l) => l.V).Num;

public static string OrderByComparableNullFirst() => [new Line(1, new Ver(5), null), new Line(2, null, null), new Line(3, new Ver(4), null)].OrderBy((l) => l.V).Select((l) => $"{l.Num}").Aggregate("", (a, b) => a + b);
public static int SumRows() => [new Cash(3), new Cash(4)].Sum().Cents;
public static int SumNoRows() { List<Cash> e = []; return e.Sum().Cents; }
public static int SumSelectedRows() => [new Line(1, null, new Cash(5)), new Line(2, null, null), new Line(3, null, new Cash(7))].Sum((l) => l.Price).Cents;
public static int GenericSumRows() => Total<Cash>([new Cash(1), new Cash(2)]).Cents;
public static int GenericSumNoInts() { List<int> e = []; return Total<int>(e); }
public static int FBoundChain() => Twice(new Sq(1)).N;
public static int FBoundClassChain() => new Box<Sq>(new Sq(1)).Two().N;
public static bool TupleNaNEquals() { float n = Math.Sqrt(-1.0); return (n, 1).Equals((n, 1)) && !((n, 1) == (n, 1)); }
public static bool TupleRowEquals() => (new Coin(1), 2).Equals((new Coin(1), 2));
public static int NullTupleHash() { (int?, int) t = (null, 1); return t.GetHashCode(); }
public static int OrderTuples() { List<(int, string)> xs = [(2, "a"), (1, "z"), (1, "b")]; List<(int, string)> s = xs.OrderBy((x) => x); return s[0].Item1 * 100 + s[2].Item1; }
public static string MaxTuple() { List<(int, string)> xs = [(2, "a"), (1, "z"), (2, "b")]; return xs.Max().Item2; }
